about.title: IT consulting, software and data systems.
about.body: I am Chamsoudine THIENTA, also known as Shams, an IT consultant, Software Engineer and Data Analyst based in Bamako, Mali. I support organizations from needs analysis to the delivery of software, APIs, databases, automations and dashboards. I also teach software development, databases, MERISE and computer architecture, with more than 200 students trained.
points: Building stronger skills in Data Engineering while staying grounded in software delivery and analytics.
Interested in banks, NGOs, telecommunications, mining, technology companies and international missions.
Designing solutions for unstable connections, modest devices and organizations still moving from manual processes to digital systems.

projects.subtitle: Case studies with clear status, confirmed stack and public links only when they exist.

kalansup.problem: University operations often combine registrations, payments, timetables, grades and documents across fragmented tools.
kalansup.contribution: Designed and built modules for an academic ERP with backend, database and dashboard workflows.
kalansup.features: Registrations, payments, timetables, grades, documents, attendance and dashboards.

storesup.problem: Small operations need clearer stock tracking and daily management without relying only on spreadsheets.
storesup.contribution: Built a MERN inventory and operations management application.
storesup.features: Stock management, operational tracking and dashboard-oriented views.
storesup.capture: No local screenshot available in this repository.

agritechmali.problem: Agricultural decisions can benefit from crop recommendations and fast plant disease identification.
agritechmali.contribution: Worked on AI-assisted crop recommendation and plant disease recognition flows.
agritechmali.features: Crop recommendation, plant disease recognition and agriculture-focused user interface.

apeda.problem: Learning difficulties and dyslexia need accessible, clear and locally understandable online information.
apeda.contribution: Created an accessible informational website for APEDA Mali.
apeda.features: Accessible content structure, responsive pages and learning-difficulty information.
apeda.capture: No local screenshot available in this repository.

ae2c.problem: An accounting and audit firm needs a professional web presence that presents its expertise clearly.

ae2c.features: Company presentation, service sections, animation and responsive layout.
ae2c.capture: No local screenshot available in this repository.

bamboolab.problem: Innovation initiatives need concise and interactive presentation formats for their audiences.

bnda-queue.problem: Banking environments can require better queue organization and service flow visibility.
bnda-queue.contribution: Built a prototype queue-management platform designed for a banking context.
bnda-queue.features: Queue management screens, service tracking concepts and real-time interaction patterns.
